build_splade_encoder: build a SPLADEEncoder from a pretrained RoBERTa model path with configurable dropout rate
run_splade_forward: run the SPLADEEncoder forward pass on tokenized input to get sparse sentence representations
create_sparse_sentence_embeddings: create sparse sentence embeddings using max pooling over log-activated transformer logits
review_spladeencoder_init: review the SPLADEEncoder init to configure dropout on attention and hidden layers
test_spladeencoder_forward: test the SPLADEEncoder forward method with attention-masked token inputs and verify output shape
